about: Long (Rachm.) hold-out test: tools/soundlibraries/make_rachm_holdout.py scores rendered with the real SSO in Kontakt 8 on the Windows test VM (kthost offline renders, 2026-10-09). q2 = Recommended preset ([slurs] quick 2, quickLevel 1, calibrated levels); q0 = quick 0 (plain Long, the reference). Events from tst_liveequivalence dumpEvents; CC1 replaced by the app's calibrated values (inverse of value 16's curve in the shipped dynamics.json, max(y, x), 1..127). Basses have no Rachm.: q0 only.

method.arrival: ms of measured arrival minus written time (negative = early). Harm: analyze_sweep.arrival on the odd+even sum, window from the previous note's written start -0.05 s to the written end +0.15 s, only after an adjacent note of a different pitch. Loud: the note's own instance (odd/even notes rendered separately), perceived envelope t15 - 30 ms; dropped when masked (envelope at the window start within 15 dB of the peak).
method.rasch: warn: |arrival| above 30 up to 50 ms; fail: above 50 ms (Rasch: 30-50 ms between players)
method.failsBoth: notes where both detectors exceed 50 ms in magnitude
method.pitchModelCV: per-pitch median offset fitted on even slur groups, tested on odd ones
method.levelDb: perceived envelope power-averaged over each slur group's written span, q2 minus q0, dB
method.unsplitCheck: levels of the unsplit violas q2 render against the odd+even sum
